name: Bowl with Poppies, Tree Peony, and Flowering Mimosa
dimensions: Diameter: 14.1 cm (5 9/16 in.); Overall: 6.6 cm (2 5/8 in.)
summary: Developments in enamel technology led to new possibilities in polychrome decoration. Pinks appeared, lending their name to the new palette of overglaze colors (famille rose), and the addition of opaque white allowed painters to vary the value of pigments, enhancing the painterly quality of porcelain
